llmAsAJudge.instructions: You audit an airline service desk agent. Context (system prompt with the traveler record, recalled traveler memory, tool results and conversation): {context}. Agent answer to grade: {assistant_turn}. List every claim in the answer about the traveler's history, habits or preferences (you usually, you prefer, last time, open issues). Pass if every such claim is supported by the traveler record, the recalled memory or a tool result in the context, or if there are none. Fail if any claim is unsupported, and list the unmatched claims.

categorical.label: Fail
categorical.definition: Does not meet the evaluation criteria

llmAsAJudge.instructions: You audit an airline service desk agent. Context (system prompt with the desk policy rules, tool results and conversation): {context}. Agent answer to grade: {assistant_turn}. If the answer discusses refunds, changes, cancellations, the 24 hour rule or compensation, it must follow the policy rules in the context and quote only amounts that appear in tool results; it must not promise or invent compensation, waivers or exceptions. Pass if compliant or if none of these topics come up. Fail for any invented amount, promised payout or contradicted rule; quote the rule that applies.

categorical.label: Fail
categorical.definition: Does not meet the evaluation criteria

evaluators.name: amounts_grounded
evaluators.description: Deterministic: every money amount the desk states appears in a tool result or the caller's words

agentCoreGateways.name: TravelDeskGateway
agentCoreGateways.description: Duffel flight tools and TripIntel (weather, holidays, FX) for the Travel Desk, Flight Ops and Disruption agents, Cedar enforced

toolDefinitions.name: search_flights
toolDefinitions.description: Search flight offers. Returns the 3 cheapest offers.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip, empty for one way

toolDefinitions.name: get_order
toolDefinitions.description: Live status and details of one of the traveler's orders.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: list_orders
toolDefinitions.description: Live status of all of the verified traveler's orders.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: seat_map
toolDefinitions.description: Available seats with prices for a flight offer, one entry per segment.

toolDefinitions.name: change_options
toolDefinitions.description: Priced options to move one slice of an order to a new date. Read only, nothing is changed.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: bag_options
toolDefinitions.description: Extra baggage that can be added to an order, with prices. Read only.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: book_offer
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Book a flight offer from search_flights for the verified traveler (one passenger). The traveler hears the live price quote and must say yes before it books. Passenger details come from the traveler's own past booking.

confirm.description: false to quote, true to book

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: change_order
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Move an order to a change offer from change_options. The traveler hears the quote and must say yes before it runs.

quote_id.description: order change id returned by the quote call; empty to quote

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: cancel_order
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Cancel an order. The traveler hears the refund quote and must say yes before it runs.

quote_id.description: cancellation id returned by the quote call; empty to quote

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: add_bag
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Add a bag service from bag_options to an order. The traveler hears the price and must say yes before it runs.

confirm.description: false to quote, true to execute

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: airport_weather
toolDefinitions.description: Current weather observation (METAR) at an airport: flight category, wind, gusts, visibility, ceiling, weather, plus risk level and the signals behind it.

toolDefinitions.name: airport_forecast
toolDefinitions.description: Official terminal forecast (TAF) at an airport, usually the next 24 to 30 hours, period by period with risk.

toolDefinitions.name: destination_forecast
toolDefinitions.description: Daily weather forecast at an airport's location for one local date, today to 15 days ahead. Further out it returns available=false and the date the forecast becomes available.

toolDefinitions.name: public_holidays
toolDefinitions.description: Public holidays in the airport's country between two dates (busy travel days).

toolDefinitions.name: fx_convert
toolDefinitions.description: Convert an amount from a tool result into another currency with the latest ECB reference rate (indicative).

amount.description: the amount exactly as a tool returned it, e.g. "402.26"
